author: Eileen Campbell
text: The problem with the covers is that they curl up at the edges, so now I use Skintac before I apply the sensor. It really works.

author: Shad Hartley
text: 'Not Just A Patch' from Walgreens works for me.  It has a center part of the adhesive backing that you leave on to prevent it from sticking to the sensor.  I'm not sure why you would want to use a patch and not cover the sensor.  I apply after a shower, and after wiping with an alcohol wipe.  Last me two weeks.  Be careful not to soak it too long under a hot shower and pat dry to prevent curling.
